title: Attribute-regionalized physical fast/delayed hydrology with zero-target-history tests
hypothesis: The five physical hydrology parameters vary predictably with ten frozen Reach attributes, allowing one unified mass-conserving fast/delayed hydrology to improve path partition without using target-station history.

candidates.R0_GLOBAL_REFIT: five global physical parameters refit without target-group data
candidates.R1_ATTRIBUTE10: five global physical parameters plus 10x5 attribute coefficients, no station physical effect

spatial_groups: ten deterministic groups from 20260823_17; each target group contributes no monthly flow or daily-separation proxy to fitting
gauge_nuisance: profiled only for training stations; never predicted or required for held-out targets

optimization.initialization: locked parent global raw parameters and zero attribute effects independently in every fold

forbidden: target station monthly observations in training
target station daily separation proxy in training
Euclidean or river-network residual in this stage
interpretation_boundary: Passing this stage supports attribute-transferable fast/delayed parameter fields, not observed groundwater or young/old water fractions.
